name: Bloom
rootCause: The Blast ecosystem project Bloom was attacked, resulting in a loss of approximately $540,000. On May 10th, Bloom announced that they had successfully recovered most of the stolen funds. The Bloom team stated that after paying a 10% bug bounty, they had retrieved $486,000 of the stolen funds, which accounts for 90% of the total amount ($540,000). All recovered funds will be redistributed to liquidity providers.

descriptions.text: The Blast ecosystem project Bloom was attacked, resulting in a loss of approximately $540,000. On May 10th, Bloom announced that they had successfully recovered most of the stolen funds. The Bloom team stated that after paying a 10% bug bounty, they had retrieved $486,000 of the stolen funds, which accounts for 90% of the total amount ($540,000). All recovered funds will be redistributed to liquidity providers.

On 9 May 2024, Bloom on Blast was exploited for approximately $540,000 due to a logic error in margin update handling. The flaw allowed the attacker to repeatedly withdraw accrued yield on positions with a negative PnL, draining protocol funds. Most of the stolen assets were later recovered through a negotiation with the attacker. A logic error in the updateTrade function responsible for margin updates. The timestamp tracking accrued yield was not properly updated for positions with negative PnL during withdrawals, allowing repeated yield extraction.
